installCommand: Install AI Job Search from the HivemindOS Skill Browser; personal data and optional dependencies are configured separately in a private workspace.
description: Run a private, local-first job search from profile onboarding through job discovery, ranking, tailored applications, PDF and ATS verification, tracking, interviews, outcomes, Gmail review, and optional Notion reporting.
securityVerdict: Conditionally approved for optional HivemindOS packaging at commit fab1e78fa293d0255d739162a4f8f82db4144876; local-first and draft-only by default, with bounded portal reads and approval gates for remote writes or employer-facing actions.

auditSummary.sourceReview: Complete repository inventory, workflow Markdown, portal source and tests, Python helpers, TeX templates, package manifests, upstream security policy, and licenses reviewed.
auditSummary.licenseReview: Upstream code and workflow content are MIT licensed. Bundled Lato and Raleway font notices include official SIL OFL 1.1 license copies.
auditSummary.dependencyReview: No package lifecycle scripts. LinkedIn and FreeHire have zero runtime dependencies; Danish portal clients have explicit dependencies but no upstream lockfiles, so HivemindOS does not auto-install them.
auditSummary.dynamicRuntime: No live portal, Gmail, Notion, submission, or email action occurs during install. Runtime network calls are explicit and bounded.
auditSummary.privacyBoundary: Personal profile, application, salary, Gmail, and tracker state stays in a user-chosen private workspace; Notion receives pipeline metadata and filenames only.

hivemindAdaptations: Adds one agent-neutral control skill that routes the complete upstream workflow without requiring Claude slash commands.
Keeps all mutable personal data out of the packaged skill and requires a user-chosen private workspace.
Vendors all six portal clients and their tests, the full profile/application method, every command workflow, PDF and salary helpers, and the default TeX templates.
Excludes the mutable curl-to-shell setup instruction and does not auto-install dependency-bearing portal packages.
Uses discovered Gmail and Notion capabilities instead of hard-coded provider tool names, with source-cited approval gates and external receipts.
Requires human approval for application submission, messages, follow-ups, mailbox mutation, and remote database writes.
Preserves upstream untrusted-posting defenses, factual grounding, drafter-reviewer separation, PDF visual inspection, and ATS text-layer verification.
